issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue asking OO to rename .biologicalSource to biologicalSourceEvent and align the short, definition, and expanded traceability comment across Device, NutritionProduct, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to PR #1975/commit 1f779e6. The source change in that branch is 440f4377b974e1f18b9d3ea96bab05c039d7ae09, later merged as d2463f86a4, which renamed the three elements and added the requested shared wording in the three StructureDefinition XML files.
additional_context: Device, NutritionProduct, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct are active resources in source/fhir.ini. BiologicallyDerivedProduct still carries the seed short/definition/comment. Device and NutritionProduct retain the shared comment but have later approved resource-specific definition wording from applied R6 issues, including FHIR-47890/FHIR-54323 for Device and FHIR-48864/FHIR-48640 for NutritionProduct; related MPHO profile wording was handled by FHIR-48790. Those related keys are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because the authoritative XML already reflects the seed plus later final decisions; reverting Device or NutritionProduct to the exact 2022 wording would undo later approved changes, and editing only SVG hover-title drift would be a generated-diagram-only change.
